literal: measure of what one has not weighing benevolence practice limit of wealth swiftly will perish
translation: Practicing benevolence without weighing the measure of one's own resources will swiftly destroy the very limit of that wealth.
modern: தன்னிடம் உள்ள செல்வத்தின் அளவை ஆராய்ந்து பார்க்காமல் செய்யும் உதவி அவனது செல்வத்தின் அளவை விரைவாக அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the dangers of excessive generosity that ignores one's actual financial capacity. The word உளவரை refers to the measure of resources one currently possesses, which must be weighed carefully. If a person practices benevolence beyond their means, the very foundation of their wealth will swiftly perish. True charity requires a clear understanding of one's own limits to remain sustainable.
